facts.fact: The Council of Ministers adopted on 17 September 2025 a draft decree creating a disaster-household database whose first stated aim is a formal cooperation framework between the civil security and crisis management delegation and the National Social Registry Programme.
facts.system: BDS-MAC (Base de Donnees Speciale des Menages affectes par les catastrophes)
